responsibility: Declares the AVR backend’s canonical architecture and MCU description types and feature enums that are shared across the target implementation and generator utilities. It defines the stable schema for core-family properties (`avr_arch_t`), per-device properties (`avr_mcu_t`), architecture identifiers, and device-specific feature bits such as short stack-pointer, RMW instructions, skip errata, and forced short calls; these tables drive `-mmcu` interpretation, built-in preprocessor macros, multilib/spec generation, and architecture lookups exposed through helpers like `avr_get_parch`.
